name: open-support-bubble
description: Self-hosted support chat bubble: a Node server plus a React widget.

scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter @open-support/dashboard build && pnpm --filter @open-support/server build && pnpm --filter @open-support/react build && pnpm --filter @open-support/sdk build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @open-support/server test && pnpm --filter @open-support/react test && pnpm --filter @open-support/sdk test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @open-support/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-support/dashboard typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-support/react typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-support/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-support/site typecheck
scripts.publish:npm: pnpm prepublish:npm && pnpm --filter @open-support/sdk publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @open-support/react publish --access public --no-git-checks
